items.title: Single-second static deployments now support more assets
items.summary: let you deploy eligible static sites to Vercel in about a second, without a build step. They now support CSS, images, fonts, and other assets alongside HTML and Markdown.Instant deploymentsDeploy a landing page with its stylesheet and images, or a report created by your coding agent, through the  or . With the CLI, run:Vercel CLIREST APINewly supported file types include:Instant deployments support up to 100 files totaling 25 MB or less. Vercel detects eligible deployments automatically, with no configuration required.Deployments that exceed these limits, include JavaScript or other unsupported files, or are triggered by Git still build as before. The same applies to projects with a framework preset, custom build settings, a root-level  or Vercel configuration file such as , or a  directory.package.jsonvercel.jsonpublic/This update is rolling out across all plans.
